title: Bangkok Cultural Heritage Tour
places: 1N Bangkok Old City | 2N Downtown Bangkok | 1N Riverside Bangkok
overview: Discover Bangkok's temples, floating markets, and riverside charm on this cultural heritage tour through the heart of Thailand's capital.
includes: Grand Palace, Wat Pho & Wat Arun visits
Great for first-time visitors & culture lovers

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok
items: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi Airport; meet & greet by local representative.
Transfer to your hotel in Bangkok Old City & check-in.
Evening stroll at Khao San Road.
Overnight in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Grand Palace & Temple Tour
items: Visit the Grand Palace and Wat Phra Kaew.
Explore Wat Pho, home of the Reclining Buddha.
Cross the river to Wat Arun, the Temple of Dawn.
Evening dinner cruise on the Chao Phraya River.

itinerary.title: Floating Market & Shopping
items: Morning visit to Damnoen Saduak floating market.
Explore Chatuchak weekend market.
Leisure time at a riverside night market.
Overnight in Downtown Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Departure
items: Breakfast at hotel.
Last-minute shopping near your hotel.
Transfer to Suvarnabhumi Airport for your onward flight.
End of your Bangkok Cultural Heritage Tour.

title: Thailand Beaches & Island Hopping
places: 2N Phuket | 2N Krabi | 2N Phi Phi | Island Hopping | Water Sports
overview: Experience Phuket, Krabi, and Phi Phi Islands with turquoise waters and scenic beaches. A perfect blend of island tours, snorkeling, and leisure time.
includes: Phuket, Krabi & Phi Phi Island stays

itinerary.title: Arrival in Phuket
items: Arrive at Phuket International Airport; meet & greet by local representative.
Transfer to hotel & check-in.
Relax at Patong Beach.
Explore night markets or enjoy the vibrant nightlife.

itinerary.title: Phuket City Highlights + Big Buddha
items: Phuket City Tour covering Karon Viewpoint & Old Phuket Town.
Visit the iconic Big Buddha on Nakkerd Hill.
Explore Wat Chalong Temple.
Evening leisure near beachside cafés.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Island Tour
items: Speedboat ride to Phi Phi Don & Phi Phi Leh.
Snorkeling in crystal clear waters.
Visit Viking Cave & Pileh Lagoon.
Lunch included on the island.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Krabi + Ao Nang Beach
items: Scenic transfer from Phuket to Krabi.
Check-in at hotel near Ao Nang Beach.
Sunset walk along the beachfront.
Optional: Thai massage or café hopping.

itinerary.title: Krabi 4-Island Hopping
items: Explore Chicken Island, Poda Island, Tup Island & Phra Nang Cave Beach.
Snorkeling & swimming in turquoise waters.
Enjoy white-sand beaches with limestone cliffs.
Return to Krabi hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure
items: Breakfast at hotel.
Airport transfer for your return flight.
End of your Thailand Beaches & Island Hopping tour.

title: California Dreams Road Trip
places: 2N SF | 3N LA | 1N San Diego | Highways | Beaches | City Highlights
overview: Drive along California's most iconic coastal and desert routes, from Los Angeles beaches to Yosemite's granite peaks and San Francisco's bay. A road trip blending city highlights, national parks, and unforgettable views.
includes: Los Angeles, San Diego & San Francisco stays
Sunset views at Santa Monica & Golden Gate Bridge

itinerary.title: Arrival in Los Angeles
items: Arrive at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX).
Pick up your rental car and check-in at the hotel.
Visit Santa Monica Pier & enjoy the beach sunset.
Explore the Los Angeles nightlife or relax at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles City Highlights
items: Explore Hollywood Walk of Fame.
Visit Dolby Theatre & TCL Chinese Theatre.
Drive up to Griffith Observatory for city & Hollywood Sign views.
Optional: Visit Universal Studios Hollywood.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles to San Diego
items: Drive along Pacific Coast Highway towards San Diego.
Visit La Jolla Cove for beautiful ocean cliffs.
Explore Old Town San Diego or Gaslamp Quarter.
Overnight stay in San Diego.

itinerary.title: San Diego to Palm Springs
items: Morning visit to Balboa Park or San Diego Zoo.
Drive to Palm Springs through scenic desert landscapes.
Check-in & relax at your Palm Springs resort.
Evening stroll at Palm Springs Downtown Village.

itinerary.title: Palm Springs to Yosemite National Park
items: Drive towards Yosemite via Fresno or Bakersfield route.
Enter Yosemite National Park and explore its scenic viewpoints.
See Tunnel View, El Capitan & Bridalveil Fall.
Overnight stay near Yosemite.

itinerary.title: Yosemite to San Francisco
items: Morning nature walk or short hike in Yosemite Valley.
Drive to San Francisco through Central California.
Visit Pier 39 & Fisherman's Wharf.
Evening view of the Golden Gate Bridge.

itinerary.title: San Francisco Departure
items: Explore Lombard Street (world's most crooked street).
Visit Union Square for last-minute shopping.
Drop off rental car at the airport.
Depart from San Francisco Airport with unforgettable memories.

title: Disneyland & Universal Family Adventure
places: 2 Parks | Universal Studios | Disneyland | Family Fun
overview: A magical family getaway through Disneyland, Disney California Adventure, and Universal Studios Hollywood, packed with rides, characters, and unforgettable shows.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Los Angeles
items: Arrive at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX).
Meet & greet and transfer to your hotel.
Evening visit to Santa Monica Pier or stroll at Venice Beach.
Overnight stay in Los Angeles.

itinerary.title: Disneyland – Full Day
items: Full-day excitement at Disneyland Park in Anaheim.
Enjoy classic attractions: Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, Space Mountain.
Meet Disney characters and enjoy live shows.
Evening parade & spectacular fireworks show.

itinerary.title: Disney California Adventure Park
items: Spend the day at Disney California Adventure.
Experience Cars Land, Pixar Pier, and Avengers Campus.
Enjoy 3D & 4D rides like Soarin' Around the World.
Return to hotel for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios Hollywood
items: Visit Universal Studios for thrilling movie-themed adventures.
Explore Wizarding World of Harry Potter.
Ride Transformers 3D, Jurassic World & Studio Tour.
Evening leisure at Universal CityWalk.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles Departure
items: Breakfast at hotel.
Quick stop at Hollywood Walk of Fame (if time permits).
Transfer to airport for your onward flight.
Trip ends with magical family memories.

title: Maldives Luxury Water Villa
places: 3N Overwater Villa | Speedboat Transfer | Water Sports | Private Island Luxury
overview: Unwind in an overwater villa surrounded by turquoise lagoons. A luxury Maldives escape built around water sports, spa treatments, and pure relaxation.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Maldives
items: Arrive at Velana International Airport, Maldives.
Experience snorkeling, kayaking or paddle boarding.
Enjoy resort activities like beach volleyball & lagoon swimming.
Romantic candlelight dinner by the beach.

itinerary.title: Water Sports & Island Activities
items: Relax with a floating breakfast in your water villa.
Try snorkeling or diving in the house reef.
Enjoy a sunset dolphin-watching cruise.
Evening cocktails at the overwater bar.

itinerary.title: Leisure Day & Spa Experience
items: Leisure time to explore your private water villa.
Indulge in a relaxing couple's spa treatment.
Sunset cruise or dolphin watching (optional).
Enjoy a fine dining experience at resort restaurant.

itinerary.title: Departure from Maldives
items: Breakfast at the resort.
Check out and transfer back to the airport.
Board your flight with unforgettable tropical memories.

title: Maldives Honeymoon Special
places: 2N Beach Villa | 2N Water Villa | Candlelight Dinner | Sunset Cruise
overview: A romantic Maldives honeymoon featuring beach and water villa stays, private candlelight dinners, and a sunset cruise for two.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Maldives
items: Arrive at Velana International Airport.
Transfer to your resort by speedboat or seaplane.
Check-in to your romantic Water Villa / Beach Villa.
Enjoy a honeymoon welcome with sparkling juice & flower decoration.

itinerary.title: Island Activities & Water Adventures
items: Start your day with a floating breakfast (optional).
Enjoy snorkeling, kayaking & paddle boarding.
Relax by the lagoon or infinity pool.
Romantic private beach dinner at night.

itinerary.title: Spa Therapy & Sunset Cruise
items: Couple's spa session for relaxation & rejuvenation.
Leisure time at your villa or resort beach.
Evening sunset cruise or dolphin watching.
Candlelight dinner with romantic ambience.

itinerary.title: Leisure Day for Honeymoon Moments
items: Enjoy private time in your Water Villa.
Optional: Scuba diving, jet ski, parasailing.
Explore resort photography spots for honeymoon memories.
Enjoy fine dining or in-villa dining experience.

itinerary.title: Departure from Maldives
items: Breakfast at the resort.
Check out and transfer to the airport.
Fly back home with unforgettable honeymoon memories.
